name: Nantendo
author: im fernando
description: Fall between the saws above the spider portal at 30.3% to continue playing as the wave. Go below the saw right below the ship portal at 30.7% and then quickly hold before hitting the spikes to continue playing as the wave. Go below the saw right below the UFO portal at 31.3% and then quickly hold before hitting the spikes to continue playing as the wave. Go below the cube portal at 31.7% and then navigate through the following saws and structures until 32.2% where you can fall to the ceiling, avoid the ball portal and, navigate through the gameplay as the wave until 33.5% where you can fall back to the ceiling. Stay at the ceiling for the rest of the level.
